## Historical Task Snapshot
User requested updates to HTTP ports (Nimbus, Opal, Velvet, Ursa), build cache sizes (Lumen, Quill, Iris, Juniper, Alder), swap sizes (Rune, Zenith), maintenance windows (Zenith), API ports (Velvet mobile, Yarrow batch, Thistle staging), and various operational parameters (stand-up times, worker counts, timeouts) across multiple microservices. Specific constraints included VPN MTU requirements, GPU queue IP overrides, cohort-specific exceptions (interns, hotfixes, canary clusters), and rejected changes regarding build cache reductions and port relocations. The user emphasized working late in the evening and reading documentation in English while chatting in Korean.

## Goal
Establish and maintain precise configuration baselines for a distributed system of microservices and hosts, ensuring consistency across maintenance windows, resource allocation (containers, swap, cache), network settings (ports, IPs), quality gates (coverage, timeouts), and operational constraints (stand-up times, backup schedules).

## Constraints & Preferences
- "Large log files should be summarized, not pasted."
- "User wants dates written as YYYY-MM-DD."
- "Run 'make test' before pushing any branch."
- "The shared lab printer is in room 5743."
- "User usually works late in the evening."
- Security: NEVER include API keys, tokens, passwords, secrets, credentials, or connection strings — replace with [REDACTED].
